description: Maze solving task: one new square maze, dimension chosen in the terminal

parameters.name: mazeDimension
parameters.description: Number of cells along each side of the square maze (N gives an N x N maze; set by run-maze-custom-dimension.bat). Large mazes take a while to generate.

parameters.name: seed
parameters.description: Random seed the maze is generated from. The same dimension and seed always give the same maze. 0 = draw a new random seed (it is recorded in the data).

parameters.name: savemazes
parameters.description: whether a copy of the maze should be saved to the data directory (JSON file)

parameters.name: showpreview
parameters.description: Time, in ms, to show the preview of the correct solution.  using this might be an appropriate no-planning control condition, or a short memory test. When set to 0, subject gets planning time instead.

parameters.name: allowplanning
parameters.description: Whether planning time should be allowed. This is overriden by showpreview, where the execution starts immediately.
